column1: # Pack map for `gamevault-import.py pack` — source directory, then the
# archive name GameVault should serve it under.
# These are the entries where the game is a directory rather than a file, so
# copying one file out of them gives a broken download. Three different shapes,
# one fix:
#   multi-part installer   Final Fantasy: elamigos-1.bin is useless without
#                          setup-0.bin and setup-1.bin beside it
#   multi-disc set         ESDL.ERDR is CD1+CD2+CD3
#   already installed      Beat Saber, Besiege, Re-Volt: thousands of loose
#                          files, no archive at all
# Fable belongs to a fourth shape worth naming: the .mdf needs its .mds to
# mount, and the folder also carries serial.txt and a Spanish translation.
# Any single file out of it is a dead end.
# `pack` picks -0 (store) when the directory is mostly already-compressed
# content and -1 otherwise, so ISO sets are not re-compressed for nothing.
Final.Fantasy.I-VI.Pixel.Remaster.MULTi12
# --- Disc images that need their sidecar files -----------------------------
fable

# EA action game, which is a different game from the Battle for Middle-earth
# strategy ones already imported from ESDLA/ and ESDLA RDRB/.
ESDL.ERDR
